name: Access0x1SessionBudgetHook
description: Caps a person's own swaps with an Access0x1 SessionGrant budget. The owner opens a session whose delegate is this hook; an exact-input swap that carries the session id is charged against it, and a swap past the budget, after expiry or after revocation reverts. Only the session's owner can charge it. Swaps without a session pass untouched. No fee, no funds, no admin.

reasons: No dynamic fee and no returns-delta bit.
Swaps without hook data pass untouched; charging a session needs hook data and a router the owner trusts.

state.name: trustedRouter
writtenBy: setRouterTrust, by the owner for themselves

math.format: raw units of the swap's input token

externalCalls.trust: Access0x1's own contract; spend enforces delegate, budget, expiry and revocation.

externalCalls.target: a router the session owner trusts
externalCalls.trust: Chosen by the owner. Gas-capped, try/catch.

accessControl.caller: the session's owner, directly or through a router they trust

securityAssumptions: SessionGrant.spend enforces the budget and lets only the delegate spend.
doesNotGuarantee: The budget counts raw input-token units; mixing input tokens in one session mixes units.
Does not cap swaps that do not carry the session id.
Exact-output swaps cannot be charged and revert if they carry a session.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly beforeSwap, mask 0x80.
Swaps are charged until the budget is gone, then refused.
For any split, a session never pays out past its budget.
Nobody but the owner can spend the session.
Swaps without a session are untouched.
